description: This file is a PHPUnit test case for the ResetPasswordDao class, part of the OrangeHRM authentication module. It contains setup code and test methods for testing reset password request persistence, retrieval, and validation update.

classes.name: ResetPasswordDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ResetPasswordDao class, verifying save, retrieve, and update functionalities for password reset requests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates DAO and service objects, loads fixture data, and configures mock services.

methods.name: testSaveResetPassword
methods.description: Tests saving a ResetPasswordRequest entity and verifies the email and reset code fields.

methods.name: testGetResetPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a reset password log entry identified by a reset code, verifying the email address.

methods.name: testUpdateResetPasswordValid
methods.description: Tests updating the validity status of a reset password, asserting that the number of affected rows is greater than zero.
